in_hebrew.name: Heppman
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו He who manages or serves
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Heppman הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Heppman is derived from the Old German word 'heff' meaning 'to serve' or 'to lift'. This name was used as a surname for someone who managed or served a lord or was a servant in a monastery. The name can be considered a variant of the name Heinrich, which means 'ruler of the home'.
